prompt: Create a polished visual design reference board for Benchmate, an independent manufacturer-funded project companion demo for novice makers. This is a synthetic design exercise: no manufacturer partnership or technical validation is implied. Board purpose: final bounded visual refinement of a working responsive web app, including entry, first-layer observation, adhesion recovery and completion. One wide 16:9 board. Main left 65%: a full desktop app entry frame, with warm ivory #f6f4ee background, dark olive #34392e type, forest #485d3d action, terracotta cat illustration, muted sage details. Header: original simple benchmate. wordmark, tiny Demo indicator. Compact four-phase progress: Prepare, At the printer, Print, Finish. Split main content: original sculptural seated cat with rounded body, connected head, ears and curled tail in peach/terracotta with subtle fine horizontal print layers; on the right tasteful warm Fraunces-like serif headline 'A little cat. Made by you.' Short supporting text, compact Bambu Lab X1 Carbon / PLA Basic / Textured PEI setup summary and one green 'Make this project' button. Calm editorial creative-tool composition, precise typography, generous air; no glass XR panels or dashboard cards. Right 35%: three vertical thumbnail states, clearly captioned FIRST LAYER, RECOVERY, FINISH. First layer shows original annotated plate drawing of flat joined lines and one primary next step plus a secondary Something looks wrong link; labeled demonstration, never a live feed. Recovery shows an amber inset, plain detergent cleaning guidance, stop failed attempt and restart from setup, never resume detached print. Finish shows same cat named Miso, 'A gift', demo journey complete, note line and Save project record. Include a small mobile layout thumbnail or margin diagram showing the illustration above the task at a narrow width, comfortable touch targets. Include subtle token swatches and scale/radius annotations in the outer board margin. Keep every design factual UI label human-readable but treat all generated text as reference only. Avoid print durations, temperatures, sensor readings, automatic diagnosis, file download buttons, chat bubbles, badges implying real completion, printer controls, and Bambu logos. Aim for a distinctive, calm, refined product, restrained simple geometry and warm tactile print detail. Static composition only; no animation or motion design is requested.
